name: metis-dev
description: Root convenience scripts for running the FastAPI backend and Next.js frontend together in development. Not published; the actual apps are api/ (Python) and frontend/ (Next.js).

scripts.dev:backend: python -m uvicorn api.main:app --reload --reload-exclude frontend/* --reload-exclude data/* --reload-exclude .next/* --reload-exclude node_modules/* --reload-exclude .venv/* --reload-exclude .git/*
